notes.title: [PATCH] Update #3 now available
notes.content:
Hello Heroes,

Update #3 is now available on Steam

Please find below complete change log of this patch

[b]H3HD - PC Patch #3[/b]
- Fix issue: Mouse Lag
- Fix issue: No music in campaign cutscenes
- Fix issue: Constant disconnections or players kicked from multi game
- Fix issue: Crash if launching a multiplayer game before others players are ready
- Fix issue: Overpowered creature (Lizardman)
- Fix issue: Spoils of War campaign – Can’t continue as Krewlod several occurrences
- Fix issue: Heroes who are not from Necropolis class shouldn't be able to learn "basic necromancy" by level up.
- Fix issue: Issue with Charisma skill (wrong total bonus)
- Fix issue: The number of the creatures in Heroes' army is missing. (PL)
- Update localization
- Fix bugs with the Whisper feature. 

Whisper feature is now available in online multiplayer mode. To send a message to a specific player, you need to type your text and use F5-F12 inputs to target (F5 for player1, F6 for player2 etc.).

- Fix issue: Heroes who are not from Necropolis class shouldn't be able to learn "basic necromancy" by level up.
- Fix issue: Issue with Charisma skill (wrong total bonus)
- Fix issue: The number of the creatures in Heroes' army is missing. (PL)
- Fix bugs with the Whisper feature.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Now available
notes.content:
Hello Heroes, 

Update 1.1 is now available on Steam.

The team is currently working on disconnections during multiplayer and other major issues (crashes) for upcoming patches. 

H3HD - PC Patch 1.1
* Polish Localization update
* Fixed various localization issues and truncated names
* Fixed in-game multiplayer exploits
* Fixed some causes of crashes when entering multiplayer
* Fixed achievements issues

Don’t forget to share your different logs to help the team to reproduce issues and identify solutions in the best delays. Check out this thread for more information: http://steamcommunity.com/app/297000/discussions/0/610573567802022633/

notes.title: Update 1 - Now available!
notes.content:
Hello Heroes,
the first patch for H3HD is now available on Steam!

H3HD - PC Patch 1 
* Fixed Anti-virus crashes/ Error code 2 
* Fixed unexpected assert failure crash during a battle 
* Fixed resolution issues because of high DPI 
* Fixed the flag color issue with brown hero/town flag 
* Fixed crash when selling artefact 
* Fixed random crash by clicking on tavern 
* Fixed issue with "nwconlyamodel" cheat code in multiplayer mode 
* Added in game tips and warning 
* Special characters have been limited for the moment as using them in saves' names corrupt the save 
* Fixed FR issue about random object in Chest 
* Fixed polish localization issues 
* Fixed russian autosaves issues 
* Fixed polish credits button glitch 

Additional information: 
Please verify that you have Direct X, Visual c++ and Net. Framework up to date, we recommend you to play with at least the min/recommended configuration described in Steam store.

notes.title: Upcoming Patch
notes.content:
Hello Heroes,

The first patch of Heroes III – HD Edition should be available in the next few days. We will update this news as soon as we have a full release date to share.

Thank you again for your support. Do not hesitate to share bugs on the following thread http://steamcommunity.com/app/297000/discussions/0/604941528473197086/ or contact our Customer Support for more information http://support.ubi.com.   

Please find underneath a first list of main fixes included in this patch.

[b]H3HD - PC Patch 1[/b]
* Fixed Anti-virus crashes/ Error code 2
* Fixed unexpected assert failure crash during a battle
* Fixed resolution issues because of high DPI 
* Fixed the flag color issue with brown hero/town flag
* Fixed crash when selling artefact
* Fixed random crash by clicking on tavern
* Fixed issue with "nwconlyamodel" cheat code in multiplayer mode
* Added in game tips and warning
* Special characters have been limited for the moment as using them in saves' names corrupt the save
* Fixed FR issue about random object in Chest 
* Fixed polish localization issues
* Fixed russian autosaves issues
* Fixed polish credits button glitch

[b]Additional information:[/b]
Please verify that you have Direct X, Visual c++ and Net. Framework up to date, we recommend you to play with at least the min/recommended configuration described in Steam store.
